pages.title: Neutronium Plating
pages.text: Neutronium rolled into flat plates and riveted onto a block face. It is grey, dense and almost reflective, with seams that look as though they were drawn with a ruler. It gives a lab the look of a reactor vault.
Made in a $(item)Stonecutter$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Block of Neutronium, Neutronium Plating Slab, Neutronium Plating Stairs, Neutronium Plating Wall.
